newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HANSA, HOIU GET FIRST-HALF RESULTS BOOST.
newsitem.headline: HANSA, HOIU GET FIRST-HALF RESULTS BOOST.

text.p: * Total trade on the Estonian bourse on Friday was 52.4
million kroons versus Thursday's 60.2 million kroons.
* The Talse index gained 1.28 percent to close at 282.60.
* Hansapank was the most active stock with 14
million kroons traded to close 3.3 kroons higher at 152.70
kroons.
* Hoiupank turned over 11.7 million kroons to
finish two kroons higher at 156.00 kroons.
* Tallinna Pank fell 1.10 kroons to 63.10 kroons
on trade of four million kroons. It yesterday said it wanted to
take over Latvian Saules Bank but uncertainty prevails over its
plans.
* Uhispank , which on Friday announced its
half-year results, traded 7.3 million kroons to gain 0.04 kroons
to 53.69 kroons.
(See index on stock exchange web site:
http://www.tse.ee/online/total.htm)
The market responded positively to Hansapank's and Hoiupank's half-year results, giving their shares and the overall market a boost on Friday.
Hansapank, which gained 3.3 kroons to 152.70 in the most active trade, released its half-year results on Thursday after the bourse closed. It has also said it will raise its 1997 profit forecast.
Hoiupank, which posted a record June profit yesterday, continued rising and closed two kroons higher at 156 kroons on 11.7 million kroons.

But Tallinna Pank suffered, falling 1.10 kroons to 63.10 kroons. Dealers said its June financial results were not so impressive and that speculative interest over a possible merger with Hoiupank had gone.
Local media has reported earlier that Hoiupank and Tallinna Pank have started merger talks, but Tallinna yesterday announced it was not considering a merger in Estonia.

Tallinna also slipped in the wake of an announcement that it wants to take over Latvia's Saules Banka. The market has been cautious over the news due to uncertainty over the outcome and because details are not yet known, dealers said.
Uhispank released its half-year results and said it will raise its 1997 profit forecast in August. The bank saw moderate trade to gain 0.04 kroons to 53.69 kroons.
Forekspank gained 2.4 kroons to 197.15 in trade of seven million kroons although its results are not out yet.
The free market turned over 7.5 million kroons and Tallinna Kaubamaja was the most active in trade of 3.3 million kroons.
-- Eva Palu, Tallinn newsroom, +372 6209 201, reuters@reuters.ee
